summary: Recommends separate inventory files or directories per environment so you choose the target with -i, since a shared inventory requires all its vault passwords and could expose production secrets to developers.
questions: Should production and staging share an inventory file?
How do I avoid developers seeing production secrets in inventory?
How do I choose which environment a playbook runs against?

answer_card.title: Separate production and staging inventory
answer_card.answer_md: Use separate inventory files or directories for production, staging, test and development, and select one with `-i`. Mixing them in one file invites surprises: every vault password used in an inventory must be available to use it, so developers using a combined inventory could access production secrets.
